-- clean --
CC := gcc
CFLAGS += -O2
SRCS := $(wildcard *.c)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)
export TOKEN := secret

.PHONY: all clean

all: app

app: $(OBJS)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -o $@ $^ && echo "$$TOKEN"

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c -o $@ $<

clean:
	rm -f app $(OBJS)
